items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: my uncle Joey was a saxophone player

ctx.x: See the thing, to start it off this way, I usually start off my interviews by saying my father was the oldest of five brothers and one sister. All of the boys were professional musicians. And my father was the oldest, and he played banjo and guitar, my uncle Georgie, George Napoleon played the saxophone, my uncle Teddy was a drummer, my uncle Joey was a saxophone player — and who else, there were five brothers — Pop, Georgie, Teddy, Joey—
